title: topology: .harness/config/topology.json
description: The project's layering rules for the topology skill, as data. Every key is optional; with no file only the generic checks (no cycles, no phantom dependencies) run. topology.py reports an unknown key at the top level, in `phantoms`, in a group, in `route` or in `route.maven` as a violation (`verify` exits 1). The only `$` key it accepts is `$schema`, at the top level: a `$comment` is an unknown key there. Globs: `*` stays within one path segment, `**` crosses segments; a glob that selects packages matches the package name or its directory relative to the root.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

workspaces.description: Package directory globs, used instead of pnpm-workspace.yaml / the root package.json `workspaces`. `!glob` excludes. Default: autodetected.

extensions.description: Suffixes of the source files scanned for imports (an empty list means the default). Default: [".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".mts", ".cts"].

exclude.description: Path globs whose files are not scanned (e.g. "**/examples/**"). Default: [].

phantoms.description: The phantom-dependency check: something imported in a package's code that its own package.json does not declare.

scope.description: "all": every bare import must be declared. "workspace": only imports of workspace packages. "off": no phantom check. Default: "all".

rootDependencies.description: Dependencies declared in the root package.json count as declared for every package. Default: true.

ignore.description: Imports that are not phantoms, each with its reason. An ignore without a reason is itself a violation and does not apply. Default: [].

import.description: Glob on the package name or the import specifier.

in.description: Package glob the ignore is limited to. Default: every package.

reason.description: Why it is not a phantom. Required.

groups.description: Named package groups the rules refer to. A package may belong to several groups. Default: {}.

isolated.description: No member may depend on another member. Default: false.

leaf.description: Members may depend only on their own group plus `mayDependOn`. Default: false.

mayDependOn.description: Groups a leaf group may also depend on; each must be a group defined here. Default: [].

reason.description: Printed with this group's violations. Optional.

forbidden.description: Forbidden edges between groups; `from` and `to` must name groups defined in `groups`. Default: [].

from.description: Group whose members may not depend on `to`.

to.description: Group the members of `from` may not depend on.

exceptions.description: Edges excused from the forbidden, isolated and leaf rules (never from cycles or phantoms). An exception without a reason is itself a violation and does not apply; one that excuses nothing is reported as stale. Default: [].

reason.description: Why the edge is allowed. Required.

route.description: The `route` command: bounded contexts and their domain vocabulary.

maven.description: Maven routing. false switches it off; an object configures it; absent or true autodetects from the reactor.

root.description: Reactor root directory, or a list of them; modules are read recursively from <module> entries. Default: the root pom.xml, else the top-level pom.xml files found.

contexts.description: Directory glob(s), one directory per bounded context (e.g. "backend/contexts/*"). Default: none; each module whose directory ends in `domainSuffix` is a context, with its sibling <ctx>-* modules as layers.

domainSuffix.description: Marks the module whose types are the context's vocabulary. Default: "-domain".

expectedLayers.description: Layers every context should have (e.g. ["domain", "application", "infrastructure"]); contexts missing one are flagged in `route`. Default: [].

excludeTypePaths.description: Path globs of type files left out of the vocabulary (e.g. "**/ports/**"). Default: [].

packages.description: Package globs whose exported class/interface/type/enum names form a vocabulary (TypeScript routing). Test and story files are skipped. Default: [].

patternSuffixes.description: Suffixes that name a pattern, not a concept; they sort last in the vocabulary. Default: ["Repository", "Service", "Resource", "Mapper", "Client", "Scheduler", "Job", "Exception", "Port", "Validator", "Factory", "Config", "Controller", "Handler", "Adapter", "Dto", "Props"].

note.description: One line printed after `route` output (e.g. where the pattern catalog lives). Default: none.
